title: A frozen Neumann collar makes high Steklov lower asymptotics uniform in radius

statement.quantifiers: All eps>0 admit R_eps,J_eps such that all radii r>=R_eps and indices j>=J_eps obey the same bound. Fixed n>=3 and fixed positive cone slope a.
statement.assertion: For slow polar ends in N210, the scaled positive Dirichlet-to-Neumann eigenvalues satisfy r sigma_j(r)>=(1-eps)[j/(kappa_d a^d)]^(1/d), kappa_d=2/d!, uniformly in radius.
assumptions: Global polar end dr²+f(r)²h_logr; h_t precompact C-infinity, fixed area and ||partial_t h_t||C0→0.
f(r)/r→a>0; fixed logarithmic collar width delta>0.
Positive Dirichlet energy/minmax and free Neumann inner collar boundary.

inputs: Slow uniform angular geometry and radial cone-slope convergence; compact angular metric-family Weyl law.
outputs: Uniform high-index lower spectrum independent of the enclosed interior geometry.
interface.precision: Asymptotic existence of R_eps,J_eps; no computable rates or finite-N spectral certificate.
costs: Collar regularity and angular precompactness must be acquired, not inferred from Ricci curvature or volume ratio alone.
The finite frozen-cone script verifies capacity algebra only.

proof_mechanism: Restrict the full Dirichlet minimum to the collar with free inner trace to obtain a lower quadratic form.
Freeze the angular metric at log r and compare every test-function energy and outer norm uniformly with the exact cone.
Solve the two-end Neumann radial ODE: p+=-(d-1)/2+sqrt((d-1)^2/4+lambda/a²), scaled eigenvalue p+(1-e^-delta(2p++d-1))/(1+[p+/(p++d-1)]e^-delta(2p++d-1)).
Precompact-family Weyl law lambda_j=(j/kappa_d)^(2/d)(1+o1) is uniform in angular metric; high-lambda collar eigenvalues~sqrt(lambda)/a.
Apply minmax comparison uniformly in large r, separately from later Gram determinant transport.
obstructions: Pointwise Weyl asymptotics at each radius do not permit exchanging high-index and large-radius limits.
No general no-foliation or Ricci-only conclusion follows.
Abstract eigenlabel cycling does not prove geometric realization or matching lower bound.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Acquire a fixed-width uniformly coercive rescaled collar and uniform boundary norm comparison; separately control trace-measure evolution and independent global solutions.

review.source_reported: Single-agent analytic derivation and finite capacity calculations; no new independent ingestion reconstruction or scientific replay.
